answer: Use a synchronized human-attention gate. First, each account books the same five-minute epoch window. Second, it receives a live video prompt: turn a walnut in your hand while reading a fresh sonnet line. Third, reviewers check continuous motion and reject reused clips. Fourth, only passing accounts receive one voting ticket. At a specified $12 hourly labor rate, 100 accounts require 100 simultaneous people and $100 per epoch, excluding review costs; AI-generated video remains a bypass risk. It is a tundra checkpoint where every traveler must show up before the fire dies.
